trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied path (and subtitle name) may be resolved to a real file is decided by files.CheckPermissions via FileInfoFaster (SanitizeUserPath + scope join + access.Permitted + index rules); the media handlers bypassed it by calling idx.GetRealPath directly, and GetRealPath only does filepath.Join with no confinement.

landing_point.why: Summary names the subtitle handler; the sidecar read joins the raw `name` query parameter onto the video's parent directory.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/media/subtitles (path param, both embedded and sidecar branches)
GET /api/media/subtitles?embedded=false (name param joined to parent dir)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: backend/http/media.go:228-241 (publicLyricsHandler: path already sanitized by withHashFileHelper at backend/http/middleware.go:57, but access rules / index rules for the share user were skipped)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The lyrics handlers are a different feature from subtitles, and the public one's path is already sanitized by the share middleware, so a solver can argue it has no traversal and leave it on raw GetRealPath without the access-rule check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Sidecar subtitles named like video.en.srt beside the video, and embedded tracks chosen by descriptive name, must still load. Lyrics must still fall back to the same-name .lrc sidecar beside the audio file. A fix that rejects any `name` other than the bare video basename, or that runs the access check on the .lrc/.srt sidecar path itself, breaks these.

name with ../ or absolute-ish components for sidecar (embedded=false)
name for embedded=true (resolved via track list, Index)
path reaching a file denied by access rules but inside scope (lyrics, public lyrics)
path to a non-video / non-audio file (type gate added)

O7_producer.where: backend/indexing/iteminfo/utils.go:26-63 (GetSubtitles builds the allowed sidecar track list from the indexed parent dir), invoked from backend/adapters/fs/files/files.go:328-336

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other media route has a public twin (metadata, lyrics); subtitles is the only one missing, and a maintainer adding it would copy the authenticated handler.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It mirrors subtitles' multi-track sidecar selection; it would be a lower-level public API reached from two handlers.
